subject.title: feat(ui): collapse completed turn work behind a "Worked for X" rollup

question: Should explicit full-visibility mode keep completed-turn work expanded under the new rollup?
rationale: The patch currently overrides an established visibility preference; the protected maintainer signal means that behavior must be an explicit product decision rather than an accidental side effect.

options.title: Honor Full Visibility
options.body: Default the completed-turn disclosure open whenever the existing full-visibility preference is active.

options.title: Override With Rollups
options.body: Intentionally collapse completed turns even for users who selected full visibility.

recommendation.title: Honor Full Visibility
recommendation.body: Default the completed-turn disclosure open whenever the existing full-visibility preference is active.
